about_the_game:
WELCOME to the FINANCIAL FREEDOM PROGRAM, asset. You're now property of SynForce.

Survive as a debt-bound operative in a broken system. Complete contracts for SynForce to earn your freedom, each payment unlocking deadlier weapons and strategic equipment. Storm through corporate strongholds, manipulate markets, and slaughter rival companies as commanded. The deeper you go, the more you’ll question who’s really pulling the strings.

GAMEPLAY

  • Fast-paced FPS combat across corporate facilities

  • Break into heavily guarded company sites

  • Build your arsenal of weapons and equipment

  • Take on increasingly dangerous missions

FEATURES

  • Varied environments and enemy types

  • Multiple mission approaches and loadout combinations

  • Dark corporate sci-fi setting set in the year 2350

  • Streamlined gameplay focused on action and exploration

DEVELOPMENT Created solo in Unreal Engine 5, this is my first game - a focussed FPS that merges tight gunplay with a dark corporate sci-fi world.
